subject: Use _Thread_local to solve threads.h build issue (#1053)
reason: The change only replaces a conditional #include <threads.h>/__thread fallback with the equivalent C11 keyword _Thread_local for the thread_local macro in zmalloc.c. It is a build/portability fix with identical runtime semantics (the same thread-local storage class for the used_memory thread index), so there is no behaviour change to test: any build that compiles produces the same code as before.
